title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Offshore Electrical Supervisor - Drillship in Brazil - Local payroll


* Offshore Experience working on a drillship or Semi is essential *


Overview


We are seeking an experienced and proactive Electrical Supervisor to oversee all electrical systems and operations onboard a drillship.

In this role, you will ensure high operational efficiency, compliance with safety standards, and support smooth offshore drilling activities. This role is critical to ensuring the continued success of our offshore operations while fostering an inclusive, safety-first work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse offshore environment. Candidates with leadership capabilities, technical expertise, and experience in drilling operations are encouraged to apply.


Responsibilities

  • Supervise the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of onboard electrical systems, including complex drilling and offshore equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, electrical codes, and offshore operation standards.
  • Coordinate with the drilling and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems in daily operations.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance schedules for electrical equipment and systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of all electrical systems to identify and address potential hazards or failures.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to a diverse team of electricians and support crew members.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and implement long-term solutions for system efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of electrical works, inspections, breakdowns, and necessary upgrades for equipment.
  • Contribute to the safety culture on the drillship by adhering to and promoting a safe work environment, including performing safety audits and toolbox talks.
  • Work within teams to prepare for emergencies and respond promptly to electrical system failures or incidents.


Experience :

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisor role, preferably on a drillship or semi-submersible
  • Strong understanding of marine electrical systems, offshore drilling equipment, and high-voltage systems.
  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical systems, managing control panels, and handling PLC systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of international offshore standards, electrical codes, and safety regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and work with diverse teams in high-pressure and dynamic environments.
  • Physical fitness to work in an offshore setting, with appropriate certifications (e.G., BOSIET, HUET, or OGUK Medical Certificate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to ensure effective collaboration across teams.


Day-to-day

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair electrical systems to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Oversee electrical team members, assigning tasks and providing technical guidance as needed.
  • Communicate with the drilling and operations team to address any immediate power or system issues affecting performance.
  • Monitor and report electrical maintenance progress to onboard management and onshore support teams.
  • Document all findings during inspections and repairs, updating maintenance logs accordingly.
  • Provide mentorship to less-experienced team members, fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.G., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.G., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events;
    personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.G., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - Latam
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Cientista De Dados / Ai Engineer Sr
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior AI / ML Engineer para liderar o desenvolvimento e a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning em escala. Essa pessoa será protagonista na construção do nosso ecossistema de IA, atuando com GenAI, NLP, visão computacional, entre outros, com impacto direto em produtos, processos e decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Propósito da posição


Você será responsável por transformar dados em decisões inteligentes, liderando frentes técnicas e estratégicas com foco em inovação, eficiência e impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos, integrações e fundações de ciência de dados e IA, trabalhando em colaboração com áreas envolvidas.
  • Propor, construir e acompanhar soluções fim a fim: desde o mapeamento da necessidade, proposição e desenho de solução, exploração do dados, treinamento, produtização e escala do modelo, análise e monitoramento dos seus resultados, além do acompanhamento do seu ciclo e consumo, garantindo pontos de condução ética e legal.
  • Evoluir o ecossistema de Data & AI para que esteja saudável, atualizado e à frente do mercado, com construção conjunta com áreas parceiras como Arquiteturas, Engenharias de Aplicações, Sustentação, Negócios e Riscos.
  • Estabelecer, guiar e avaliar melhores prática, capabilities, engines, aceleradores, padrões e frameworks em cases e soluções técnicas,
  • Avaliar, aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de governança, ética, justiça, explicabilidade, segurança e compliance em modelos de IA.
  • Conduzir e estabelecendo um grande Centro de Excelência habilitador de jornada com responsabilidade.
  • Criar parcerias e manter proximidade com Big Techs, alianças e universidades criando programas e laboratórios como parte evolutiva do ecossistema.
  • Colaborar ativamente com Data Strategy alinhada ao Business Strategy e tendências de mercado, construindo a visão de business x technical capabilities.
  • Contribuir em frentes culturais com o propósito de educar, capacitar, conscientizar, além de elevar o nível de maturidade em dados e IA na organização


Técnicas

  • Desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos de IA e ML em ambientes de produção.
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados e ML com foco em escalabilidade e governança.
  • Atuar com modelos supervisionados, não supervisionados, GenAI, NLP, LLMs e sistemas de recomendação.
  • Monitorar e ajustar modelos em produção para garantir performance e acurácia.

Estratégicas e culturais

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas e contribuir para a visão de IA na companhia.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de IA responsável (fairness, explicabilidade, compliance).
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com arquitetura, produto, dados e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a formação de um CoE de IA e promover a maturidade analítica da organização.
  • Conectar a estratégia de dados com a estratégia de negócio.

Stack técnica

  • Linguagens: Python (obrigatório), SQL
  • Bibliotecas: Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers (Hugging Face), OpenAI, Llama LLM
  • MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Airflow, CI/CD

Plataformas: Databricks, Azure (preferencial), AWS ou GCP

  • Bancos: Delta Lake, SQL, NoSQL
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado
  • 5+ anos de experiência com ciência de dados e IA em produção
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/IA
  • Experiência com MLOps, deploy de modelos e monitoramento
  • Conhecimento em modelos generativos (LLMs, embeddings & orchestration, prompt engineering)
  • Experiência com pipelines em cloud (preferencialmente Azure/Databricks)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de referência de governança de IA (envolvendo pontos como Responsible AI, AI Fairness).

Diferenciais

  • Compartilhar o GitHub ou qualquer outro repositório de portfolio para conhecermos seu trabalho
  • Experiência com time series, recomendação e modelos de visão computacional
  • Atuação prévia em CoEs ou iniciativas de IA Corporativa
  • Pós-graduação, certificações ou publicações relevantes

Se você quer trabalhar com IA de verdade, com liberdade para inovar e gerar impacto, essa vaga é pra você!!!

title: Profissional Design.
description:
Código da vaga:54047


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência prática em UX Design.

Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipação (Figma).

Vivência com métodos de pesquisa de usabilidade e análise de comportamento do usuário.

Capacidade de traduzir insights em soluções de design claras e funcionais.

Atuação em projetos digitais (web e mobile).

Experiência com Design System, identidade visual e criação de componentes.


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior User Experience Designer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

Responsibilities

  • Guide the UX product team on all phases of UX methodologies (e.G. discovery interviews, user journeys, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, usability testing).
  • Clearly articulate and define domain UX strategy and communicate design decisions to stakeholders that deliver business value and user satisfaction while meeting deadlines on multiple projects.
  • Prioritize work request with product management to deliver quality deliverables on schedule.
  • Represent UX domain team in cross-functional communication.
  • Establish usability testing guidelines and principles.
  • Promote understanding of brand identity and working within an established design system. Expand design system with research and incorporate new digital design components as they evolve.
  • Create low- and high-fidelity wireframes and prototypes demonstrating user’s journey.
  • Make strategic and tactical domain UX decisions on design and usability for features and task.
  • Effectively pitch wireframes, prototypes, solutions to stakeholders, product management, and senior management.
Qualifications

Requirements

  • 7 to 10 years of experience working on complex design concepts with medium to large teams is preferred, preferably in an enterprise environment.
  • Highly proficient in human-centered designed principles, user research, usability, and accessibility.
  • A strong portfolio with design examples demonstrating all phases of UX methodologies across multiple projects.
  • Expertise in Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud suite and Microsoft suite.
  • Solid foundation in Agile project methodology.
  • Preferable: previous experience in creating digital solutions for the Oil & Gas industry.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences;
    to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors;
    partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner;
    reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity;
    cares holistically for those served;
    maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered;
    treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.
Minimum Requirements
  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $120 per hour
